deadline_display: No more grants for 2026: 'You can no longer apply for a grant for internships continuing into 2026. There is no more budget available for 2026. A budget will be available again in 2027. You can reapply for internships taking place in 2027 as from January 2027.' Within a funded budget year: 'You can submit your grant application up to six months in advance until one day before the start of your internship.'
application_period: The 2026 budget is exhausted and applications for 2026 are closed. The 2027 budget reopens for applications in January 2027 for internships taking place in 2027, and new internship vacancies will be published on the programme's internships page from late 2026 onwards. Inside a funded budget year the published rule is that you may apply at any time of the year until one day before your internship starts, up to six months in advance, but a grant is only granted while budget remains.

title: ANU Vice-Chancellor's International Achievement Award
deadline_display: Application period: Open for applications. ANU publishes no closing date for this award; consideration is automatic with the admissions application.
application_period: Continuous. ANU's scholarship page shows the application period as 'Open for applications' with no closing date, because no separate scholarship application is required: all eligible students applying for admission to commence at the University are considered automatically.

title: Japan Africa Dream Scholarship (JADS) Program
deadline_display: The African Development Bank publishes no central JADS call opening or closing date, so there is no central deadline to quote. Applications go only through the partner universities, and the AfDB's own "List of Universities" page publishes each partner's intake and application window: Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University - "Application Deadlines are as following: April Enrollment: October / September Enrollment: April"; Hiroshima University Graduate School of Advanced Science and Engineering - "Month of Intake: April - Preliminary Survey: Oct 18-29 - Application period: Nov 8-19 - Exam. Period: Nov 29-Dec 8" and, for its second course, "Preliminary Evaluation for Apr. Oct 4-8, Preliminary Evaluation for Oct.: Mar. 7-11, Application Period for Apr.: Nov 4-15, Application Period for Oct.: Apr. 4-22"; The University of Tokyo Graduate School of Frontier Sciences - "Month of Intake: April or October / Examination: Schedule A (application period: mid June) Schedule B (application period: mid November)"; Sophia University - "Month of Intake: September / Deadline of Application: Web entry: Mid of March ~ Early April; Application: Mid of April". Kyoto University and Kogakuin University are listed with "Please refer to the program website".
application_period: Annual partner-university admissions cycle. As published by AfDB on 2026-10-01, the next windows relative to that date are: Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University April-intake deadline in October 2026; Hiroshima University preliminary survey 18-29 October 2026 and application period 8-19 November 2026; Hiroshima University second course preliminary evaluation 4-8 October 2026; The University of Tokyo Schedule B application period in mid November 2026. AfDB states there is no separate application to the Bank and no central JADS window.

title: UNHCR Tertiary Refugee Scholarship Programme (DAFI) - Albert Einstein German Academic Refugee Initiative
deadline_display: No single global deadline is published. Deadlines are set per country operation and published on the UNHCR country help pages (published 2026/2027 examples: Rwanda 7 August 2026; Kyrgyzstan 21 August 2026; Slovakia 31 August 2026). Applicants must check their own country operation's call.
application_period: Country-specific. The 2026/2027 cycle ran on country-published windows in July-August 2026 (Rwanda 15 July-7 August 2026; Kyrgyzstan 7 July-21 August 2026; Slovakia 1 July-31 August 2026). New country calls for the next cycle are announced on the relevant UNHCR country help page and applications are submitted through the DAFI Programme Management Platform.

title: University of Glasgow Sanctuary Scholarship
deadline_display: Applications for this scholarship for the 2027-28 academic session will open soon. In the meantime please provide your details and we will be in touch when the scholarship is open for applications.
application_period: For the 2027/28 academic year the scholarship is announced and not yet open for applications: the University states applications 'will open soon' and invites applicants to register their interest in the meantime. No opening date or closing date has been published for the 2027/28 cycle.

title: Programa RESTART — 4ª Edição (FCT research funding after parental leave)
deadline_display: Applications open 01 October 2026 at 14h and close 13 November 2026 at 17h (Portuguese time)
application_period: 01 October 2026 (14h) to 13 November 2026 (17h). The 2026 FCT contest calendar lists the opening notice for October 2026, provisional results in April 2027, and the programme page shows 'Atualizado em 1 Outubro 2026'.

title: Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship (NPGS)
deadline_display: The NPGS application window is open annually from October/November to December. The application period for Academic Year 2027-2028 will be announced in due course. The application period for National Institute of Education (NIE) will also be announced in due course. (NTU Research Programmes Admission Guide: for the August intake the application portal opens on 1 October and the last day for submission of the online application with supporting documents is 31 January, with school-specific deadlines of 15 November for ADM, SoH, SSS and WKWSCI, and 31 December for LKCMedicine and RSIS.)
application_period: Annually from October/November to December for NPGS, with outcomes sent by email together with the offer of admissions. This sits inside NTU's research degree application periods: August (Semester 1) intake - portal opens 1 October, university last day 31 January; January (Semester 2) intake - portal opens 1 June, university last day 31 July.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship (entry in the academic year 2027/8)
deadline_display: Applications for entry in the academic year 2027/8 are now open. Two rounds. US citizens resident in the USA must apply in October - Application deadline Wednesday 14th October 2026 (Full application must be submitted by 11:59pm UK time on the date given). All other eligible applicants - Application deadline dependent on your course, either Tuesday 8th December 2026 or Wednesday 6th January 2027 (Full application must be submitted by 11:59pm UK time).
application_period: Applications opened 11th September 2026 for entry in the academic year 2027/8. Round 1 (US citizens resident in the USA only): open 11 September 2026, deadline 14 October 2026. Round 2 (all other eligible applicants): open 11 September 2026, deadline set by the Course Funding Deadline for the specific course, either 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027.

title: CLP Future Conservationist Awards 2027
deadline_display: Stage 1 concept notes must be submitted by Friday, October 30, 2026 (23:59 GMT). Late, incomplete or ineligible submissions will not be considered.
application_period: Stage 1: concept notes due 30 October 2026, 23:59 GMT. Stage 2: only shortlisted (highest-scoring) concept note applicants are notified and invited to submit a full application via the CLP online application portal; detailed guidelines for the full application are provided to those who reach this stage.

title: Ernst Mach Grant – worldwide
deadline_display: Closing date for applications: 01.12.2026. Online application is possible from September to December 1st; the application deadline for this grant is December 1st, 2026, 23:59 (CET) for all applications for stays during the academic year 2027/28.
application_period: Online application open from September 2026 and closing 1 December 2026, 23:59 CET, for research stays during the Austrian academic year 2027/28 (starting September 2027). Expert evaluation takes place after the deadline; results are expected to be published at the beginning of July 2027.
